name: Soul Winning
overview: Scripture reveals that soul winning is a divine calling marked by wisdom and fruitfulness, as those who win souls are described as wise and their labor as a tree of life (Proverbs 11:30). Believers are chosen and ordained by Christ to bear lasting fruit by going forth to teach, baptize, and bring many to righteousness, shining like stars forever (John 15:16; Daniel 12:3; Matthew 28:19). The Great Commission commands believers to preach the gospel to every creature and to actively compel others to enter God's house, emphasizing the urgency and scope of this mission (Mark 16:15; Luke 14:23).
